champion.tips: BEL'VETH TIPS AND TRICKS Weave in as many auto-attacks as you can to make full use of your kit and damage. Go for extended trades as much as possible. Your PASSIVE and basic abilities work well in conjunction with one another when you go for longer fights. Avoid using your E aggressively during the laning phase unless the enemy is unable to escape. They can quickly disengage while you’re standing still.
champion.builds: THE BEST BEL'VETH BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Bel'Veth Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, as well as Cosmic Insight and Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Kraken Slayer as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Stridebreaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Wit's End, Death's Dance and finish with Jak'Sho, The Protean. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 53.9% winrate over 9 717 matches played. Optional Your second option for Bel'Veth Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Press the Attack as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Cosmic Insight with Magical Footwear in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Kraken Slayer, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Stridebreaker as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Wit's End, Death's Dance and Jak'Sho, The Protean. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 53.4% win rate over 786 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace in the primary tree, and Sudden Impact with Treasure Hunter in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Blade of The Ruined King as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Kraken Slayer as a third item. You want to finish the build with Wit's End, Death's Dance and Jak'Sho, The Protean. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 54.8% win rate across 566 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Bel'Veth Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Fleet Footwork, Triumph, Legend: Alacrity and Coup de Grace as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Triple Tonic as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Kraken Slayer as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Stridebreaker as third item. The last 3 options are Wit's End, Terminus and Jak'Sho, The Protean. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 59.0% win rate over 559 matches played. Situational Bel'Veth Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Bel'Veth build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Bel'Veth runes page.
